The attack does not come in through the mathematics: it comes in through the clock, through the power consumption, through the error messages, through a faulty random generator. It is the difference between a cipher and a system, and it is where almost every real disaster happens.

Estos ataques no son de laboratorio. La: These attacks are not laboratory ones. Power consumption measurement is used to clone cards and remote controls; the 2003 timing attack on RSA worked across the network; the PlayStation 3's nonce flaw allowed people to sign their own software and could not be fixed, because the key was already exposed. That is why the chips in cards and phones carry physical countermeasures, and why cryptographers' unanimous advice is: do not implement the algorithms yourself, use a reviewed library and keep it updated.
